_doc: SHRINK-ONLY known violations for scripts/check-smoke.mjs (pnpm check:smoke). known.<heavy|lazy>.<marker name> = routes it still fires on before engagement / before settle ("*" = every route). cls.<route> = the CLS ceiling allowed on that route while its shift is open (default 0.02). A known entry still prints as KNOWN; one that stops firing fails as STALE until deleted. Never add an entry to get green.
